scope: Original sample camp vignettes for art presentation, no deterministic game outcomes or new rules

cards.title: A ration divided
cards.text: One piece crosses the table. Someone remembers who offered it.

cards.title: A borrowed watch
cards.text: A lamp moves to another ledge. The routine has changed.

cards.title: An empty place
cards.text: The table is set. One place remains untouched.

cards.title: A seam in the ward
cards.text: The stone has been repaired before. The join can still be found.

cards.title: The price of a whisper
cards.text: A covered hand waits beside the payment.

cards.title: Before the grille
cards.text: Beyond the bars, the sand is being swept.
